selectionRule: First lexicographic s1grd individual file path under sample/ in the pinned provider tree; select its matched before, after, label and validity files. No raster or label bytes inspected. Center 256x256 window on documented 1024x1024 grid, never substitute another crop after inspection.
geometryCompatibility: unknown: relative orbit, pass direction, look direction and incidence not supplied by this sample manifest; no temporal ratio or attribution permitted
radiometry: Provider card and code assert linear sigma0 VV,VH; not independently radiometrically calibrated by Earthsignal
maskPolicy: validity==1, labels in 0/1/2, per-band finite positive power <=1000 per pinned producer loader; raster native valid mask also required. Unknown definitions fail.
analysis: Per-date per-VV/VH summaries on the same common valid population by provider class; counts, native projected cell area and P05/P25/P50/P75/P95. No pixel-independent confidence intervals, classifier scores, hazard/causal claims or NISAR transfer.
license: CC-BY-4.0 compilation/labels; modified Copernicus Sentinel-1 and CEMS Rapid Mapping products © European Union; no DEM acquired
minimumSummaryPixelsMeaning: Engineering display gate, not a scientific sample-size or independence guarantee
